The resolution keeps both sides in each, and `page` stays in the effect's dependency list beside main's two new ones.

The merge's `bun install` rewrites the workspace self-versions main's bun.lock is stale on, so the lockfile must be restored from main@origin and committed without running `bun install` again - an install after the restore puts the new versions straight back, which is how the first restore commit landed empty (6a197786; 5a069c7e is the real one).
